name: Homeland

components.pose: She stands on a high vantage with her homeland spread out behind her, one hand lifted slightly toward it, her face turned to the camera with quiet ownership; full figure visible, the land wide and clear behind her.
components.effects: Drifting shadow, smoke and pale starlight drift softly in the air around her, a trace of {{MAGIC}} light that belongs to this country.

notes: REALM SERIES: Homeland in her darkness homeland (establishing); realistic, from realms/darkness-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/darkness.
